summary: The official Ministry of Land Affairs directory identifies Mwene-Ditu as a land and cadastral circumscription in Lomami, providing local custodian evidence. The bounded anonymous requests found no public parcel geometry, stable parcel identity, schema, CRS, or city adapter. Runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and French first-party discovery queries are recorded in city-5166-mwene-ditu.json. They found the official Ministry directory, formal land-search procedure, and cadastral digitization document catalogue, but no public parcel layer.
requestOutcomes: Official HTML, JSON catalogue, robots, and linked backend WordPress routes were fetched anonymously with TLS verification enabled. The guessed Ministry API route returned 404. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, TLS disablement, formal land-search submission, or unsafe property lookup was used.
scopeLimits: The Mwene-Ditu listing proves a local/regional cadastral custodian route, not public parcel geometry availability.
The formal land-search page is a procedure requiring property references and potentially identifying information; it was not submitted.
The pilot digitization document catalogue is institutional evidence only and does not expose a verified parcel API.
No exact-point hit or miss, map extent miss, timeout, or unavailable UI was treated as evidence of citywide cadastral absence, and the WUP point was not shifted.
No GeoJSON sample was retained because no safe native parcel geometry and identity response was obtained.
This packet is research evidence only and must not be treated as source integration or adapter admission.
